title: aeluropus lagopoides
intro: Aeluropus lagopoides, commonly known as Salt Grass or Sea Salt Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Aeluropus lagopoides include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues, attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
